stories.excerpt: Welders at work. Uganda’s skills challenge is about producing workers whose capabilities match actual production needs. PHOTO/ MICHAEL KAKUMIRIZI
stories.summary: Uganda’s skills challenge is about producing workers whose capabilities match actual production needs. In comparison, the unemployment rate among young people aged 15–24 years in the labour force is higher, at 17.9 percent. Youth unemployment was higher among females at 21 percent, compared to 15.2 percent among males.

stories.title: Monetary policy’s dilemma Prosper 7 hours ago Listen
stories.excerpt: Uganda Shillings. On September 24, the Bank of Uganda increased its Cash Reserve Requirement from 11 percent to 13.5 percent. PHOTO/MICHAEL KAKUMIRIZI
stories.summary: A Central Bank sets one price, the interest rate. The interest rate is only half the central bank’s toolkit. Bank lending rates have hovered around 20 percent since 2011, whatever the Central Bank does.
